task: strict 1:1 vs permissive-call BUSTED FDR rate sensitivity (reviewer 1, P2)
one_line_conclusion: BUSTED FDR-significant rates differ between strict one-to-one orthologs (1345/4119 = 32.7%) and permissive-call genes (345/855 = 40.4%; Fisher OR = 0.72, two-sided P = 2.1e-05): permissive-call genes show an elevated coding-selection rate. Because permissive calls are only 17.2% of the universe, the impact on the universe-wide rate is bounded (strict-only 32.7% vs overall 34.0%).
